notes: Short clips finish sooner. Crisp now starts upscaling once the first 10 seconds of a clip are ready, instead of waiting for all of it. On our test Mac a 30-second 1080p video reached 4K in 2 minutes 42 seconds, down from 3 minutes 8 seconds. The picture is the same. Clips that use a denoise, low-light or film-repair option are processed exactly as before.
